get.summary: List hosted compute network configurations for an organization
get.desc:
Lists all hosted compute network configurations configured in an organization.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:network_configurations` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

post.summary: Create a hosted compute network configuration for an organization
post.desc:
Creates a hosted compute network configuration for an organization.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `write:network_configurations` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

name.description: Name of the network configuration. Must be between 1 and 100 characters and may only contain upper and lowercase letters a-z, numbers 0-9, '.', '-', and '_'.

compute_service.description: The hosted compute service to use for the network configuration.

network_settings_ids.description: The identifier of the network settings to use for the network configuration. Exactly one network settings must be specified.

get.summary: Get a hosted compute network configuration for an organization
get.desc:
Gets a hosted compute network configuration configured in an organization.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `read:network_configurations` scope to use this endpoint.

params.name: org
params.desc: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: network_configuration_id
params.desc: Unique identifier of the hosted compute network configuration.
